1225. 2D Array 90-Degree Rotation

80

Problem Statement:
Write a program that accepts a 2D array of integers (a matrix) from the user, dynamically allocates memory for the matrix, and rotates the matrix by 90 degrees clockwise. The rotated matrix should then be printed as the output.
input_spec:
Your task is to handle the matrix input dynamically using heap memory. The input matrix will be square (n x n), and you need to rotate the matrix by 90 degrees clockwise. This operation involves transposing the matrix and then reversing the rows.
The first line contains an integer n, the size of the matrix (n x n).
The next n lines contain n integers each, representing the matrix.
output_spec:
.

Input Description:
Your task is to handle the matrix input dynamically using heap memory. The input matrix will be square (n x n), and you need to rotate the matrix by 90 degrees clockwise. This operation involves transposing the matrix and then reversing the rows.
The first line contains an integer n, the size of the matrix (n x n).
The next n lines contain n integers each, representing the matrix.

Output Description:
The output should be the rotated matrix, with each row printed on a new line.
